description: This file defines the BiometricAuthenticator class, a wrapper for biometric authentication using Android's BiometricPrompt API, supporting device credential fallback and providing methods to check availability and perform authentication.

classes.name: BiometricAuthenticator
classes.description: A wrapper class for handling biometric authentication with device credential fallback in an Android app.

classes.name: BiometricAuthenticator.Availability
classes.description: Sealed class representing the availability status of biometric authentication, with 'Available' and 'Unavailable' states.

methods.name: availability
methods.description: Checks if biometric or device credential authentication is available on the device.

methods.name: authenticate
methods.description: Displays the biometric prompt to the user and handles success, failure, and error callbacks.
